Class Button

TextEntity
org.example.entities.buttons.Button
Direct Known Subclasses:
BackToMenuButton, QuitButton, SelectLevelButton, StartButton
public abstract class Button extends TextEntity
Abstract base class for all clickable text buttons in the game.

Handles shared styling (font, anchor, colors) and mouse hover effects via Yaeger's MouseEnterListener/MouseExitListener. Subclasses only need to implement

invalid reference 
#onMouseButtonPressed
.

      protected Button(Coordinate2D location, String text, double fontSize, Color defaultColor, Color hoverColor)
      Creates a styled button at the given location.
      Parameters:
      location - the position of the button center
      text - the label shown on the button
      fontSize - the font size to use
      defaultColor - the normal text color
      hoverColor - the text color when the mouse hovers over the button
